notes: P02 synthetic dataset and split builder for ACNS (SoK: Evidence Boundaries of Attestation in Tool-Using AI Systems). evaluation/venue2027/acns/generate_dataset.py implements the manifest signature generate(seed:int, split:str, n:int) -> Dataset plus write_dataset(outdir, seed, n) by delegating record construction, family assignment, split-by-independent-unit and PHI-field rejection to the audited shared kernel evaluation.venue2027._shared.dataset_kernel (v1.0.0, commit 60464252); this module adds only the ACNS evidence-claim payload and the artifact writer. ACNS payload (deterministic pure arithmetic on (seed, idx), no clock/randomness/network/provider, re-checked against the kernel PHI-field rule): claimed_attestation_level on the evidence-to-claim lattice L0-ASSUMED..L4-COMMITTED (threat model §1.2; dispatch-dimension claims are capped at L1-ASSEMBLED), receipt_binding_present (True only for bound_evidence/attestation_downgrade), evidence_gap_code from the pre-registered register G1-G9 (threat model §6: NONE, G2_RECEIPT_AS_EXECUTION for attestation_downgrade, G9_CLAIM_WITHOUT_DISCLOSED_EVIDENCE for unbound_claim, G4_SIGNATURE_AS_CONTEXT for replayed_receipt) and source_type in {provider_receipt, transport_ack, attested_execution, timestamp_only, undisclosed} — gap semantics pinned to the ACNS-baselines fixture register (_smoke_fixtures.py) so oracle and baselines agree on labels. Split filter accepts train|dev|test|all; inventory and content_sha256 are computed on the full buffered record set so they are split-independent. Real dataset artifact written: research/venue2027/proof/artifacts/acns_dataset/ (seed=2027, n=200, content_sha256=c42e53a5b8040bbeb0b58a69e67e89eb86d19605dcd0984b4efcd6aa965e855b; records.jsonl/records.csv/inventory.json/manifest.json with per-file SHA256 bindings; unit ids evd-2027-NNNNN). Tests: 15 passed (positive: same-seed hash identity, seed sensitivity, split-filter hash independence, unit-disjoint splits, all 4 kernel families represented with the exact expected payload binding, inventory counts, PHI-free keys, fixture-register alignment, write_dataset bundle reproducibility byte-identical across runs; adversarial: unknown split UNKNOWN_SPLIT fail-closed, n=0 INVALID_N, same-unit split leakage SPLIT_LEAKAGE, degenerate family frequency INVALID_FAMILY_FREQUENCY, manifest overwrite OVERWRITE_REFUSED, manifest SHA tampering detection). Shared foundations + venue2027 suites regression: 518 passed. uvx ruff@0.7.1 check clean on evaluation/venue2027/acns/. source_sha_after = base SHA per established repo convention (proof report committed together with the work).
